scripts.build: NEXT_DISABLE_SWC_NATIVE_BINDINGS=1 next build && npm run export:to-docs
scripts.export:to-docs: rm -rf docs && mkdir -p docs && cp -R out/* docs/ || true
scripts.export:to-docs-local: rm -rf docs-local && mkdir -p docs-local/boemare-final && cp -R out/* docs-local/boemare-final/ || true
